claim: Code on an instance can detect an upcoming termination by polling the instance metadata item autoscaling/target-lifecycle-state, which EC2 Auto Scaling updates before the instance moves to a new steady state; the current lifecycle state cannot be read from instance metadata.
question: How can code running on an Auto Scaling instance find out that the instance is about to be terminated?

values.display: polls for the lifecycle state of an instance
You cannot retrieve the current lifecycle state

qualifiers.scope: per Auto Scaling instance, read through the Instance Metadata Service

evidence.quote: When an instance prepares to transition to one of the preceding steady states, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling updates the value of the instance metadata item `autoscaling/target-lifecycle-state`.
You can do this by writing code that polls for the lifecycle state of an instance directly from the instance.
You cannot retrieve the current lifecycle state of the instance from the instance metadata.
